parameters.content:
## WF1 — Group Bot
Every message in the group arrives here.
**Normalize** cleans it up, then **Route by type** sends it down one branch:
- **join** → track + welcome
- **leave** → mark as left
- **chat** → moderation (messages) or commands

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $('Normalize').first().json.chatId, group_title: $('Normalize').first().json.chatTitle }) }}

parameters.content:
### Join
Add each new member to the database, log it and send the welcome message.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ p_chat_id: $json.chatId, p_user_id: $json.userId, p_username: $json.username, p_first_name: $json.firstName, p_increment: 0 }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $('Track new member').item.json.chat_id, user_id: $('Track new member').item.json.user_id, username: $('Track new member').item.json.first_name, event_type: 'join' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $('Track new member').item.json.chat_id, text: $('Ensure settings').first().json.welcome_message.replaceAll('{name}', $('Track new member').item.json.first_name || 'there') }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'left' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $('Normalize').first().json.chatId, user_id: $('Normalize').first().json.leftMember.userId, username: $('Normalize').first().json.leftMember.firstName, event_type: 'leave' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ p_chat_id: $('Normalize').first().json.chatId, p_user_id: $('Normalize').first().json.userId, p_username: $('Normalize').first().json.username, p_first_name: $('Normalize').first().json.firstName, p_increment: 1 }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $('Normalize').first().json.chatId, user_id: $('Normalize').first().json.userId }) }}

parameters.content:
### Auto-moderation
Admins are skipped. Links / banned words → delete message, warn, and ban at the max warning count.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $json.chatId, message_id: $json.messageId }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $('Check violation').first().json.chatId, user_id: $('Check violation').first().json.userId, username: $('Check violation').first().json.name, event_type: 'message_deleted', details: { reason: $('Check violation').first().json.reason, text: $('Check violation').first().json.text } }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ p_chat_id: $json.chatId, p_user_id: $json.userId, p_reason: $json.reason, p_message: $json.text || null, p_issued_by: $json.by }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $json.chat_id, user_id: $json.user_id }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ warning_count: 0 }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $('Add warning').item.json.chat_id, text: '🧪 ' + $('Add warning').item.json.name + ' reached ' + $('Add warning').item.json.count + '/' + $('Add warning').item.json.max + ' warnings and would be banned now, but Telegram refused (' + ($('Ban user').item.json.description || 'admins and the group owner cannot be banned') + '). Warnings reset to 0.' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ p_chat_id: $('Add warning').item.json.chat_id, p_user_id: $('Add warning').item.json.user_id, p_status: 'banned', p_event: 'ban', p_by: 'bot', p_details: { reason: 'Reached ' + $('Add warning').item.json.max + ' warnings' } }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $('Add warning').item.json.chat_id, text: '🚫 ' + $('Add warning').item.json.name + ' was banned after ' + $('Add warning').item.json.count + ' warnings.' }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $json.chat_id, text: '⚠️ ' + $json.name + ', warning ' + $json.count + '/' + $json.max + ': ' + $json.reason + '.' }) }}

parameters.content:
### Commands
/rules and /stats for everyone. /warn /ban /mute /unmute for admins only (reply to a message).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $('Normalize').first().json.chatId, user_id: $('Normalize').first().json.userId, username: $('Normalize').first().json.firstName, event_type: 'command', details: { command: $('Normalize').first().json.command } }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $('Normalize').first().json.chatId, text: '📜 Group rules\n\n' + $('Ensure settings').first().json.rules_text }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $('Normalize').first().json.chatId, text: '📊 Group stats\n' +
  '👥 Members: ' + ($json.total_members ?? 0) + '\n' +
  '🟢 Active (24h): ' + ($json.active_24h ?? 0) + '\n' +
  '⚠️ Warnings (7d): ' + ($json.warnings_7d ?? 0) + '\n' +
  '🗑 Messages removed (7d): ' + ($json.deleted_7d ?? 0) + '\n' +
  '🚫 Banned: ' + ($json.banned ?? 0) }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $json.chatId, text: $json.error }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify($json.params) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ p_chat_id: $('Plan admin command').first().json.chatId, p_user_id: $('Plan admin command').first().json.userId, p_status: $('Plan admin command').first().json.status, p_event: $('Plan admin command').first().json.event, p_by: $('Plan admin command').first().json.by, p_details: $('Plan admin command').first().json.details }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $('Plan admin command').first().json.chatId, text: $('Plan admin command').first().json.okText }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $('Plan admin command').first().json.chatId, text: "❌ Couldn't do that: " + ($json.description || $json.error?.message || 'unknown error') }) }}
